answer: The nectar index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1990 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the copper. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the signal queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. A 451 account operation therefore ties up 20 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
